answers.core: This is about improving Control prototyping out of the box, and bringing Godots' UI workflow up to speed with the web.
answers.workaround:
You can create your own minimal theme and copy-paste it among new projects. However, this is cumbersome.

I believe that this enhancement will be used often by both new and experienced users, given the strong presence of CSS Resets on the web.

title: Add an alternative default Control theme that unstyles all parameters
